candidates.claim: rtr-01 has a MGMT-side address 10.10.99.12/24 on GigabitEthernet0 with no inbound ACL, and a default route 0.0.0.0/0 via 198.51.100.1 on the OUTSIDE link, so MGMT-sourced traffic can be forwarded to OUTSIDE without passing fw-01 or any approved-service filter.
candidates.remediation: Apply an inbound ACL on rtr-01 GigabitEthernet0 that permits only the approved MGMT cross-zone services and remove the default route toward OUTSIDE from the MGMT-side path.

candidates.claim: The baseline delta reports the access-list OT_IN entry at fw-01:75 (permit udp 10.10.10.40/32 to 10.10.20.5/32 port 123) as added relative to the approved baseline and it must be reconciled.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the added OT_IN entry at fw-01:75 against an approved change record or revert it to the baseline.
